summary: High Tide Inc., a Nasdaq/TSXV-listed Canadian cannabis retailer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 28, 2026, announcing its sixth consecutive inclusion in the Globe and Mail Report on Business ranking of Canada's Top Growing Companies, placing No. 315 of 375 with 66% three-year revenue growth and 161% Adjusted EBITDA growth for 2022-2025. No transaction, security, or corporate action is disclosed; the release is promotional/operational, citing an approximate $800M annualized revenue run rate and Remexian's German growth. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms appear. Risk-arb angle: none; treat as non-event.
